name: Cooks Coffee Company Limited
quirks: Company site is cookscoffeecompany.com (dual-listed NZX/AQSE). Reports under /investors. FY ends 31 March. 1-for-15 share consolidation 30-Mar-2022 breaks per-share history before FY2022. FY2026 reported revenue +84% to NZ$12.785m is a CONSOLIDATION effect, not growth: managed stores (Dairygold/Tesco Ireland) book full store sales while franchised stores book royalty only (Managed Cafes segment NZ$0.987m -> NZ$5.317m); franchise revenue ex-Dairygold +22.6%. Use system-wide store sales (NZ$95.8m FY2026, +22.8%) as the real top-line KPI. Shareholders equity is NEGATIVE so P/B is unusable. FY2023 NZ$2.385m Triple Two goodwill impairment and FY2024 Triple Two disposal loss are one-offs. FY2026 as-filed OCF includes a lease-receipts reclassification (~NZ$4.1m) absent from prior years - check basis consistency.
